thread:
devon: quick question — for rollout v2 we need a default contingency policy. thinking we should encode a hysteresis window to avoid oscillation when latency spikes briefly. thoughts?
elaine: yes. oscillation was painful last month. hysteresis + minimum duration seems necessary. also want a clear sampling audit so we can replay decisions.
sam: agree on hysteresis. UX ask: how do we show "why" the system cut traffic? small readout or an explainer modal?
mohit: prefer compact inline reason: eg `Triggered: p95>450ms for 3m (hysteresis 5m)` then a link to expanded log. minimize clicks.
rachel: also need to show which degrade mode was chosen and what the user-visible effects are (err codes, truncated responses, latency budget). product teams keep asking.
devon: good call. propose default degrade modes: `silent_shed` (drop low-priority requests), `graceful_trim` (shorter responses), `fallback_model` (lower-cost model). each with a short label in the UI.
elaine: +1. UX: add an inline severity indicator (info/warning/critical) and the metric that fired. critical should require explicit approval for global rollouts.
sam: small nit — sampling for audit shouldn't be just time-based. we need deterministic sampling tied to request id for replayability. otherwise we can't reconstruct traces in order.
mohit: here's a minimal policy example i sketched for the editor:
```
policy: {
  trigger: "p95_latency_ms > 450 for 3m"
  hysteresis: "extend 5m"
  min_duration: "10m"
  mode: "graceful_trim"
  audit_sample: "deterministic: 1% by request_id"
  notify: ["#platform-alerts", "ops-oncall"]
}
```
rachel: looks good. Can we expose a preview/simulate button in the console so teams can run the policy against historical telemetry (shadow run) and see expected traffic split?
devon: yes — simulation is essential. requires sandboxed playback of traces with a small compute job. UX should show expected impact: tokens saved, latency delta, error delta.
ops-bot: deploy job queued: rollout-sim-sandbox v2-preview (ETA 20m) :gear:
devon: also need clarity on quota interactions: if degrade trims tokens, does quota consumption adjust? product wants clear accounting.
elaine: agree — show both "charged tokens" and "effective tokens" in the audit row. auditors will want a statement of what was billed vs what was delivered.
mohit: edge case — oscillation when two regions flip at slightly different times. add cross-region suppression (global hysteresis token) or require majority consensus for global mode changes.
sam: can we have an escape hatch button: "revert contingency for service X" with reason required, and record a playbook link?
rachel: yes, and that revert action should be an auditable event with a timeline entry and optional postmortem link.
devon: action items: 1) console: add concise trigger reason and mode label (elaine) 2) backend: deterministic audit sampling & replayable traces (sam + mohit) 3) simulation endpoint + UX (rachel + devon) 4) quota accounting row in audit table (elaine). i'll file tickets.
elaine: i'll prototype the inline label and severity chips today.
sam: i'll start on deterministic sampling PR.
mohit: will add hysteresis primitives to policy engine.
rachel: i'll scope the simulation UI and mock the expected metrics view.
devon: thanks all — let's sync tomorrow after initial PRs. :thumbsup:
